## 中文
- **封面辅色随音乐移动。** 使用「封面取色」时，辅色会随低、中、高频的强弱平滑移动。默认横向渐变下，低频偏左，中频居中，高频偏右。辅色在封面中占比越大，延展越宽。 - **适用于浮窗、菜单栏和贴边显示。** 播放时复用现有频谱数据与渐变，切歌保留平滑过渡。
支持 macOS 14.4 及以上，包含 Apple Silicon 和 Intel 版本。已安装的用户可在菜单栏选择「检查更新…」。首次安装请下载 PrismPulse-macOS.zip，解压后将 App 拖入「应用程序」。
## English
- **Artwork accents move with the music.** In artwork color mode, the accent glides with the balance of bass, mids, and treble. With a horizontal gradient, bass pulls it left, mids bring it toward the center, and treble pulls it right. An accent that covers more of the artwork spans a wider area. - **Works in floating windows, the menu bar, and screen-edge layouts.** PrismPulse reuses the existing spectrum data and gradient during playback and blends smoothly between covers.
Requires macOS 14.4 or later and supports Apple silicon and Intel. Choose Check for Updates from the PrismPulse menu to update. For a new installation, download PrismPulse-macOS.zip, unzip it, and move the app to Applications.
